best_candidate.name: GitHub Actions Hosted Linux Runner (ubuntu-latest)
best_candidate.eligibility: Included with standard GitHub account (2,000 free minutes/month for private repos; unlimited for public repos)
best_candidate.why_best: Matches existing ATLAS CI architecture, provides native Docker daemon with root privileges, pre-installed Python 3.11, ~6.3 GB free unallocated memory (exceeds 2.5 GB envelope by 2.5x), automated artifact capture, and requires zero payment credentials.

top_candidates.name: GitHub Actions Hosted Runner (ubuntu-latest)
top_candidates.docker: Native pre-installed Docker 24+ with root daemon
top_candidates.ollama: Installable in ~10s via standard script (curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh)
top_candidates.gemma3_1b: Downloadable via ollama pull in ~15s over runner gigabit network
top_candidates.persistence: Ephemeral VM per job; artifacts retained via actions/upload-artifact
top_candidates.limitations: Requires git repository remote and workflow definition dispatch
top_candidates.security: Isolated ephemeral Azure microVM, zero cross-tenant leakage, teardown on completion

top_candidates.name: Google Colab (Free CPU Tier)
top_candidates.docker: Restricted (unprivileged container environment; no native Docker daemon)
top_candidates.ollama: Runs standalone native Linux daemon as user process
top_candidates.limitations: Interactive notebook format; lacks native Docker daemon for containerized inference adapter

top_candidates.name: Hugging Face Spaces (CPU Basic Tier)
top_candidates.docker: Native Docker Space support (runs custom Dockerfile directly)
top_candidates.ollama: Can be packaged inside the space container
top_candidates.persistence: Persistent container image with ephemeral state between restarts
top_candidates.limitations: Designed for ongoing web applications rather than one-shot CI test runs; public by default unless set private
top_candidates.security: Requires setting space visibility to Private to prevent unauthorized traffic

rejected_options.name: Existing Local Laptop
rejected_options.reason: Host RAM 7.63 GB, idle free RAM 1.31 GB (< 1.5 GB RED threshold); memory pressure causes OOM/swapping

rejected_options.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free Tier
rejected_options.reason: Requires credit card verification and billing identity registration

rejected_options.name: GitLab CI/CD Free Tier
rejected_options.reason: Mandates credit card verification for free pipeline minutes

recommended_next_action: Configure a dedicated one-shot workflow dispatch job in GitHub Actions or initialize remote repository sync to execute the bounded CS-01 canary on a fresh ubuntu-latest runner.
